licence.leaseMustBeValidToRenew.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai Humanitarian City, lease (IHC Regulations (Version 2022) Art. 14: a valid Lease is required to be licensed; the Authority may repossess property if the Lease or License is not renewed or cancelled within the stipulated timeframe, CONFIRMED); https://dubaihumanitarian.ae/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/IHC-Regulations.pdf

licence.leaseMinRemainingDays.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai Humanitarian City, lease (no minimum remaining period stated in the IHC Regulations); https://dubaihumanitarian.ae/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/IHC-Regulations.pdf

licence.renewalWindow.value: Submit the renewal request, fees and documents no later than 60 days before each renewal date. The licence term is two years from issue.
licence.renewalWindow.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai Humanitarian City, renewal window (IHC Regulations Art. 65 and Art. 19, CONFIRMED); https://dubaihumanitarian.ae/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/IHC-Regulations.pdf

licence.renewsTogether.value: At renewal of any License, Lease or Sponsorship Agreement, evidence of renewed insurance policies must be given, including employee injury and disability cover. Establishment Card renewal is a separate service in the fee schedule. The renewal must also show compliance and being actively operational in prior years.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai Humanitarian City, renews together (IHC Regulations Arts. 37 to 40 and 66, and the fee schedule, CONFIRMED); https://dubaihumanitarian.ae/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/IHC-Regulations.pdf

licence.afterExpiry.value: The Authority may terminate a licence if the entity fails to renew its expired licence or has not paid a renewal or late renewal fee, or if activities have ceased for more than 90 days. The Authority may suspend a licence at its discretion. After a termination notice the entity has 20 Business Days to respond; a Second Strike-Off Notice then gives 60 Business Days, or another period the Authority sets, plus a Public Notice; after that the entity may be struck off the Register. No fixed day count from expiry to termination.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai Humanitarian City, late renewal (IHC Regulations Arts. 70, 71, 72(a)(iv), (v), (vii) and 74, CONFIRMED); https://dubaihumanitarian.ae/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/IHC-Regulations.pdf

licence.graceDays.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai Humanitarian City, late renewal (no grace period stated in the IHC Regulations); https://dubaihumanitarian.ae/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/IHC-Regulations.pdf

licence.afterExpiryThresholds.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai Humanitarian City, late renewal (no fixed day count from expiry; the strike-off periods in Art. 74 run from notices, not from expiry); https://dubaihumanitarian.ae/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/IHC-Regulations.pdf
